subject: Re: SOC2 architecture review — evidence & SSO
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex@securehealth.io>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Margo Lee <margo@securehealth.io>
Date: 2026-09-01T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Request: SOC 2 architecture review + evidence sync

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the quick intro last week — SecureHealth is moving into procurement for our vendor controls and we'd like to schedule a technical deep-dive to review Redwood's SOC 2 scope, encryption-at-rest and in-transit approach, audit log collection, and SSO integration for our enterprise SSO (Okta).

Primary goals for the meeting:
- Confirm the list of evidence artifacts we’ll need for SOC 2 Type II (logs, retention, configuration screenshots).
- Walk through network and key management (KMS/HSM) for encryption.
- Understand how user activity and admin actions are logged and exported.
- Validate SSO/SCIM behavior for provisioning and deprovisioning.

Proposed attendees from our side: myself (security), Margo Lee (IT ops), and our procurement manager (TBD).

Can you share 60–75 minute slots next week? Also would appreciate any pre-read checklist so our engineering team can prepare.

Thanks,
Alex Chen
Security Lead
SecureHealth, Inc.
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex@securehealth.io>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-02T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 architecture review + evidence sync

Alex — thanks for the note and context. Happy to run the architecture review. Rishi (our Head of Security & Compliance) will join for the deep technical pieces.

We have the following 60–75 minute windows open next week (all PT):
- Tue 9/7 10:00–11:15
- Wed 9/8 14:00–15:15
- Thu 9/9 09:30–10:45

I’ll attach a short SOC2 evidence checklist and a high-level network diagram so your engineers know what to collect ahead of time. Can you confirm who will be the primary contact for procurement so I can include them on the calendar invite?

Pre-reads attached: SOC2-evidence-checklist-v3.xlsx, network-diagram.pdf

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: SOC2-evidence-checklist-v3.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), network-diagram.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Alex Chen <alex@securehealth.io>

Cc: Margo Lee <margo@securehealth.io>
Date: 2026-09-03T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 architecture review + evidence sync

Hi Jasmine — thanks for the fast turnaround and the attachments. Quick update from our side: our VP of IT needs to be on the call and she has a standing conflict on 9/7 in the morning, so we need to move. Of your suggested slots, Wed 9/8 14:00 PT would work best. Can we lock that?

A few asks up-front so Rishi can prioritize coverage:
- Please make sure the session covers: KMS key rotation policy, HSM usage (if any), and how backups are encrypted.
- We need clarity on retention windows for admin and API audit logs and how to export those logs for our SIEM.
- For SSO: we use Okta + SCIM and will want to review provisioning and session timeout policies.

If you can add a short agenda and the list of attendees from Redwood that would help our procurement manager decide whether to include legal on the call.

Thanks — Alex

Date: 2026-09-04T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 architecture review + evidence sync

Alex / Margo — locking Wed 9/8 14:00–15:15 PT for the architecture deep-dive. Calendar invite sent: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234

Proposed agenda (60–75 min):
1) Intros & goals (5 min)
2) Deployment & network topology (15 min) — we’ll cover VPCs, peering, and egress controls (see attached network diagram).
3) Encryption & key management (15 min) — KMS design, rotation, HSM boundaries.
4) Audit logs & retention/export (15 min) — admin/API events, retention policy, export formats.
5) SSO/scim provisioning & session controls (15 min)
6) Action items / evidence checklist review (10 min)

Attendees from Redwood: Jasmine Liu (solutions engineering), Rishi Malhotra (Head of Security & Compliance), Lauren Bishop (Customer Success). Please confirm final attendee list from your side so we can include them on the invite.

Pre-read folder (view only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1X_example_pre-read

Attachments included: SOC2-evidence-checklist-v3.xlsx, network-diagram.pdf

If procurement needs legal present, we can extend the calendar block by 15–30 minutes at the end — let me know.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2-evidence-checklist-v3.xlsx, network-diagram.pdf

Quick note from CS — confirmed for Wed 9/8 14:00 PT, we’ll join and bring the onboarding checklist and previous SOC2 artifact references for similar customers (redacted).

Pre-reads look good. Alex, can you share which Okta org URL and whether you use Just-In-Time provisioning or SCIM? That will help Rishi prepare the exact SCIM flow diagrams.

Also adding a follow-up: after the call we’ll provide a mutual action plan in HubSpot with the evidence drop-deadlines so procurement can track sign-offs (I’ll share a link during the call).

Thanks — Lauren
